hook.sub: 7 free ways to use these instead
hook.say: Stop buying gratitude journals. These cards are free, and here are seven ways to use them. Stay for the last one.

scenes.title: Family gratitude jar
scenes.say: One. Turn any jar into a family gratitude jar, and read them together every Sunday.

scenes.title: Fall jar centerpiece
scenes.say: Two. Mason jar, twine, a few real leaves. Instant fall centerpiece.

scenes.title: Pull-a-prompt bowl
scenes.say: Three. Fold prompt slips into a bowl. Everyone pulls one and shares.

scenes.title: Thanksgiving place cards
scenes.say: Four. One card on every plate at Thanksgiving. Read them out over pie.

scenes.title: Gratitude garland
scenes.say: Five. Clip them to twine for a garland that grows all month.

scenes.title: Journal reflections
scenes.say: Six. Tuck reflection cards into a journal for a calm weekly reset.

scenes.title: Hard-day reframes
scenes.say: And seven, my favorite. Reframe cards that turn a hard day around. Keep one in your bag.

end.say: They're all free. Search gratitude cards printamoo dot com.
